Here's a draft. It follows the 2026-10-20 decision: SSO isn't available today, it's planned for Q1 2027, and it's Enterprise-only, so nothing is promised for Team.

---

**Subject:** Re: SSO on Larkfield

Hi [Name],

Thanks for asking. We don't support SSO today.

We're adding SAML SSO in Q1 2027. It will be part of our Enterprise plan, not Team. If SSO is a requirement for you, I can share more about Enterprise when it's closer to launch.

Until then, your Team plan accounts sign in with email and password. If there's a specific identity provider or setup you need, tell me. I'll pass it to the team.

Best,
The Larkfield team

---

I left out any promise to add SSO to Team. The plan details come from one internal decision note, so check the Q1 2027 timing before you send.
